The active campaign admits only 4 of them: run_loop_iteration, promote_findings, bubble_up and noop (experiments/research_campaign_daily_agentic_game_theory_20260917.json:43-55). The daemon wakes every 30 minutes only to hold again (nara_daemon.py:236-252 always sees agenda:1). Two parts of an Oracle-to-Nara pipeline exist but are not connected. The first is the D-062 packet path: dispatcher, premerge gate, Qwen builder, and a daemon dispatch hook that is off unless NARA_PACKET_DISPATCH=1. The second is the D-067 lab channel, where Oracle can send `turn --as oracle`, but that is conversation only. The missing pieces are: (1) an attributable Oracle→Nara work-item mailbox with deterministic admission, (2) a daemon lane outside the coordinator that runs one bounded packet per wake while the focus hold is on, with the dispatcher defects fixed and a builder aimed at Flash :30080, (3) a receipt→page projection for work cards and accomplishments, and (4) bounded ledger organize/kill commands. Arming any runtime dispatch needs an owner-ratified DECISIONS entry, because D-062 deferred coordinator-runtime dispatch as its own gated decision (DECISIONS.md:3106).

design.mailbox_schema:
FILE: run_state/oracle_nara_mailbox.jsonl, append-only and gitignored. It is included in the daily backup snapshot (lesson from Oracle's D1 ledger-durability gap). Schema file: schema/oracle_nara_mailbox.schema.json (new; not a spine file).

COMMON ENVELOPE (every row): {schema_version:'oracle-nara-mailbox/v1', seq:int monotonic, prev_sha256:hex|null, row_sha256:sha256(canonical row minus row_sha256), ts:ISO-UTC, actor:'oracle:hq'|'oracle:pi'|'oracle:planner'|'nara'|'human:<id>'|'system', to:'nara'|'oracle'|'owner', kind, msg_id, thread_id, in_reply_to:msg_id|null, expires_at (required for plan_item/question; plan_item <=7d), provenance:{transport:'cli'|'planner_reconciler'|'daemon_lane'|'ui_argv', agenda_id?, revision_sha256?, focus_receipt_sha256?, session_id?, wrapper_request_id?}, body}.
- msg_id is content-addressed: '<actor>-'+sha256(actor+kind+canonical body+provenance.revision_sha256)[:16]. Re-posting identical bytes is an idempotent no-op; for planner items the index is folded into the body.
- Row limit is 16 KiB, with body text fields at most 8 KiB (the Pi mailbox limits).

ORACLE -> NARA KINDS:
- plan_item. body {title, objective, why_now, task_class in {documentation, tests, repository_code, deterministic_replay, draft_specification, result_projection, ledger_hygiene}, allowed_write_paths[], artifact_path, acceptance:{test_argv:[str], test_file, must_fail_before:true}, budget:{wall_clock_minutes<=30, max_attempts<=2, max_diff_lines<=400, max_output_tokens}, priority, depends_on[]}.
- withdraw. body {target_msg_id, reason}.
- answer. body {text, re_msg_id}.
- integration_receipt, oracle:hq only. body {target_msg_id, branch, head_sha, review_verdict in {merged, changes_requested, rejected}, merge_commit|null, review_ref}.
- page_update, phase 3. body {section in {goals, improvements}, items[] validated against the existing daily_ops summary contracts}.

NARA -> ORACLE KINDS:
- receipt. body {target_msg_id, state, reason_code, attempt?, packet_task_id?, branch?, base_sha?, head_sha?, artifact_sha256?, test_digest?, premerge_ok?, agent_rc?, run_log_task_id}.
- report. body {target_msg_id, summary<=2KiB (display only, never evidence), evidence:[{path, sha256}]}.
- question. body {text, re_msg_id?}.
- capability_request. body {need, evidence_refs[]}. This is Nara asking Oracle to fix the lab, UI or Nara itself.
- proposal. body {proposal_kind in {focus_change, campaign_close, scientific_kill, other}, text, evidence_refs[]}. A proposal never executes itself; it is performed only by an operator/owner CAS path.

EITHER DIRECTION: note, which is non-actionable.

OWNER KINDS:
- approve, human:* only. body {target_msg_id}.
- hold, human:* only. body {target_msg_id, reason}. Nara must honor it at the next admission or claim check.

RECEIPT STATE MACHINE:
- posted -> delivered -> admitted | held | expired | withdrawn
- held -> admitted, only via a human approve row or a new revision
- admitted -> claimed -> attempted (repeatable up to max_attempts) -> validated | rejected | blocked | quarantined
- validated -> integrated (from integration_receipt merged) | changes_requested (which closes the item; Oracle must post a new plan_item)
The writer validates every transition and refuses an illegal one. The reader fold is last-legal-state-wins per msg_id (the todo_cli pattern, todo_cli.py:151-165). An illegal row found at read time is reported loudly and never coerced (rule 4).

ADMISSION (deterministic, in nara_work_lane; reason codes are recorded in the receipt):
- actor starts with 'oracle:'; expires_at is in the future; the row validates against the schema.
- task_class is not in the always-held set (scientific_execution, scientific_registry_mutation, scientific_promotion, capital_or_market, model_or_runtime_change, service_or_schedule_change, credential_or_security, scope_expansion; per AUTONOMY_EXECUTION_CONTRACT.json).

- test_argv is non-empty (no shell).
- The budget is within the caps.
- provenance.focus_receipt_sha256, when present, equals the current focus receipt; otherwise the item is held with stale_focus.
- actor oracle:hq (a frontier model) with task_class draft_specification about research content is held under D-061.
- Planner-sourced items are held with awaiting_owner_approval until the owner decides otherwise (decision D-084).
- Pause file present: the item is queued only.
- One item may be active at a time.
- The daily budget (cap 60, 'sdlc' share) must have room; if not, the receipt records deferred:budget and the item stays admitted.

verification.verdict: REVISE BEFORE RATIFICATION. The overall shape is sound and most citations check out: a separate lab-side log, a lane outside the coordinator menu, a deterministic page projection, human-only approve/hold, Nara never merging, focus changes kept to operator CAS, and D-061 fencing. Phase 1 as written is still not safe to arm and would not reliably close the loop, for five reasons. (1) Model-written code and tests run unconfined on the host, and containment is pushed to Phase 2, against D-081's containment gate, the practice used in LAB011, and the AUTONOMY contract. (2) The `--as` CLI lets any same-uid process forge human approvals, Nara receipts and HQ integration receipts; the hash chain does not prevent this. (3) Placing the lane after _run_cycle means every mailbox wake runs a research cycle, and the lane's own writes wake the daemon again. The lane also holds the cron flock for up to about 150 min and a GPU lease that does not exclude the planner. (4) Nothing defines who authors the red-first acceptance test or keeps it unchanged, and the planner cannot emit admissible items at all. (5) Work cards depend on a volatile pending agenda. On governance, D-078..D-081, AGENTS.md, the CLAUDE.md Codex section, oracle AGENTS.md rules 4-6 and the deployed v7 runtime pins are all uncommitted, and HEAD's oracle AGENTS.md still forbids silent edits to a_bgt_rsi. Phase 0's cutover list misses the hard pins at agent_wrapper/deployment.py:149 and flash_resident.py:61-64, which would make Nara refuse every pass. A large window such as 262K would push MemAvailable below the planner's 20 GiB floor and switch off the planner, Oracle's plan source. The 64K 'not memory pressure' conclusion rests on a single monitor sample. Minimal Phase 1 that closes the loop: (a) commit governance and runtime so HEAD matches what is deployed; (b) a mailbox with five kinds, no hash chain, a lock-only store and a CLI that refuses nara, human and integration actors, with approve going through the UI bearer-token seam; (c) a foreground run-one that takes the exclusive cron flock, runs in a networkless env -i sandbox, gets its test bytes from the plan_item with sha verified, is scoped to exact file paths, and recovers orphaned claims by lease expiry; (d) integration derived from git ancestry; (e) cards bound to msg_id. Daemon wiring, the sdlc charge, the lab_channel event deriver, _ACTORS and the planner reconciler come after that loop has passed twice.
